sources.quote: A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that supplier, that part, the receiving site and the customer.

findings.why: The ASL covers BR-310 at PLT-PIN for CUST-NOR, but the only approval is for SUP-C. There is no approval for Alluminio Bormida (SUP-B) on BR-310, so SUP-B has no current release.

sources.quote: BR-310,"Roof rail bracket, extruded and cut",PRG-Y,A,MAT-6082-T5,COAT-TCP,
A change of source or a change of material requires Nordhavn approval (PPAP resubmission) before the first shipment.

findings.why: BR-310 belongs to PRG-Y, which belongs to Nordhavn. A change of source needs Nordhavn's written approval before the first shipment. No approval is in the documents.

sources.quote: BR-310,"Roof rail bracket, extruded and cut",PRG-Y,A,MAT-6082-T5,COAT-TCP,

findings.why: The drawing requires EN AW-6082-T5. Bormida is qualified only for 6082-T6 and 6061-T6, not for 6082-T5. The 6082-T6 qualification is a different temper and does not cover T5.

sources.quote: A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for the drawing material. Missing certificates are an open question for the supplier quality engineer.

findings.why: No 3.1 certificate is on file for SUP-B and MAT-6082-T5, the drawing material of BR-310. Bormida's certificates cover only 6082-T6 and 6061-T6. The owner is the supplier quality engineer, Elena Gallo.
